description: React component for an interactive scene with audio, characters, dialogue, and controls in a learning platform.

classes.name: Scene
classes.description: React functional component representing an animated scene with characters, dialogue, and audio controls.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Preloads an image from a given source URL.

methods.name: audioLoaded
methods.description: Callback when audio is ready to play, sets scene as ready.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Handles playing the scene, including audio and animation synchronization.

methods.name: handlePause
methods.description: Pauses the scene's audio and animation.

methods.name: handleStop
methods.description: Stops the scene, resets state and audio.

methods.name: resetAnimation
methods.description: Resets character animations and scene state.

methods.name: onNotify
methods.description: Handles scene control events: play, pause, stop.
